features.name: Wizardly Quill
features.desc: You create a magical quill; you copy spells into your spellbook faster and more cheaply.

features.name: Awakened Spellbook
features.desc: Once when you cast a spell, you can change its damage type to another from your spellbook; you can cast any spell that uses a spell slot as a Ritual.

features.name: Manifest Mind
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you summon a spectral mind (10-foot light); you can cast spells through it and use it to protect yourself from damage.

features.name: Master Scrivener
features.desc: You create a Spell Scroll from your spellbook for a reduced cost.

features.name: One with the Word
features.desc: When you would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, you erase part of your spellbook to drop to 1 Hit Point instead (once per Long Rest).

features.name: One with the Word
features.desc: As an action, you turn a scroll into a spell slot or vice versa.
